current_command.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; Set-Location (Resolve-Path '.').Path; git add -A; $staged=(git diff --cached --name-only); if($staged){ git commit -m 'chore: finalize shutdown handoff' | Out-Host }; git push origin main | Out-Host; $local=(git rev-parse HEAD).Trim(); $remote=(git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main | ForEach-Object { ($_ -split '\s+')[0] }).Trim(); if($local -ne $remote){ throw ('REMOTE_HEAD_MISMATCH local='+$local+' remote='+$remote) }; $dirty=(git status --porcelain); if($dirty){ throw ('WORKTREE_NOT_CLEAN count='+($dirty | Measure-Object).Count) }; Write-Output ('GIT_SYNC_OK head='+$local); $since=Get-Date; $os=Get-WmiObject -Class Win32_OperatingSystem -EnableAllPrivileges; if(-not $os){ throw 'WIN32_OS_WMI_NOT_AVAILABLE' }; $result=$os.Win32ShutdownTracker(15,'User requested shutdown after Git sync',0,12); $rv=[int]$result.ReturnValue; Write-Output ('WMI_SHUTDOWN_RETURN='+$rv); if($rv -ne 0){ throw ('WMI_SHUTDOWN_FAILED return='+$rv) }; $ev=$null; for($i=0;$i -lt 10 -and -not $ev;$i++){ Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500; $ev=Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='System'; Id=1074; StartTime=$since.AddSeconds(-2)} -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1 }; if($ev){ Write-Output ('SHUTDOWN_EVENT_CONFIRMED id='+$ev.Id+' time='+$ev.TimeCreated.ToString('o')+' provider='+$ev.ProviderName) } else { Write-Output 'SHUTDOWN_EVENT_NOT_YET_VISIBLE_BUT_WMI_ACCEPTED' }; Write-Output 'WAITING_FOR_POWER_OFF'; Start-Sleep -Seconds 30; Write-Output 'ERROR_HOST_STILL_RUNNING_AFTER_SHUTDOWN_DEADLINE'; exit 2"
